source: OMG BPMN 2.0.2 (formal/2013-12-09), as modelled by @bpmnkit/core's bpmn-model.ts and parser

traits.name: flowElement
traits.description: Parsed as a flow element of a process or sub-process: exactly the parser's FLOW_ELEMENT_TYPES, including the data elements and the model-only eventSubProcess.

traits.name: event
traits.description: Event that may carry event definitions (the parser's EVENT_TYPES).

traits.name: loop
traits.description: Activity whose multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics child is read (the parser's LOOP_TYPES).

traits.name: container
traits.description: Holds a flow of its own: sub-process kinds (the parser's CONTAINER_TYPES).

traits.name: eventDefinition
traits.description: Event definition the parser reads under an event (the parser's EVENT_DEFINITION_TYPES).

traits.name: defaultFlow
traits.description: Gateway that models a `default` sequence flow: exclusive, inclusive and complex.

elements.name: baseElement
elements.description: Root of the BPMN type hierarchy: everything may carry an id, documentation and extension elements.

elements.name: documentation
elements.description: Human-readable text attached to an element.

elements.name: extensionElements
elements.description: Container for elements of other namespaces, such as zeebe:*; kept verbatim on a round trip.

elements.name: rootElement
elements.description: An element that sits directly under `definitions`.

elements.name: definitions
elements.description: The document element: a set of root elements plus the diagram interchange.

elements.name: flowElement
elements.description: Anything that can sit inside a process or sub-process flow.

elements.name: flowNode
elements.description: A flow element that sequence flows connect.

elements.name: incoming
elements.description: Id reference (element text) to an incoming sequence flow.

elements.name: outgoing
elements.description: Id reference (element text) to an outgoing sequence flow.

elements.name: activity
elements.description: Work performed in a process: tasks, call activities and sub-processes.

elements.name: task
elements.description: An activity with no specific type.

elements.name: serviceTask
elements.description: Automated work done by a service or job worker.

elements.name: scriptTask
elements.description: Automated work done by a script.

elements.name: userTask
elements.description: Work a person does.

elements.name: sendTask
elements.description: Sends a message.

elements.name: receiveTask
elements.description: Waits for a message.

elements.name: businessRuleTask
elements.description: Evaluates a business rule, e.g. a DMN decision.

elements.name: manualTask
elements.description: Work done without any automation.

elements.name: callActivity
elements.description: Calls another process.

elements.name: subProcess
elements.description: An activity that contains a flow of its own.

elements.name: adHocSubProcess
elements.description: A sub-process whose inner activities run in no fixed order.

elements.name: transaction
elements.description: A sub-process whose activities succeed or are compensated together.

elements.name: eventSubProcess
elements.description: Model-only name: a bpmn:subProcess with triggeredByEvent="true". BPMN has no element of this name; the parser and writer map it to and from subProcess.

elements.name: event
elements.description: Something that happens during a process.

elements.name: catchEvent
elements.description: An event that waits for a trigger.

elements.name: throwEvent
elements.description: An event that raises a trigger.

elements.name: startEvent
elements.description: Starts a process or sub-process.

elements.name: endEvent
elements.description: Ends a path of the flow.

elements.name: intermediateCatchEvent
elements.description: Waits for a trigger in the middle of the flow.

elements.name: intermediateThrowEvent
elements.description: Raises a trigger in the middle of the flow.

elements.name: boundaryEvent
elements.description: Catches a trigger while its host activity runs.

elements.name: gateway
elements.description: Controls how sequence flows diverge and converge.

elements.name: exclusiveGateway
elements.description: Follows exactly one outgoing flow.

elements.name: parallelGateway
elements.description: Follows all outgoing flows.

elements.name: inclusiveGateway
elements.description: Follows every outgoing flow whose condition holds.

elements.name: eventBasedGateway
elements.description: Follows the flow of the first event that happens.

elements.name: complexGateway
elements.description: Gateway with a custom activation condition.

elements.name: dataObject
elements.description: Process data scoped to its container.

elements.name: dataObjectReference
elements.description: Reference to a data object.

elements.name: dataStoreReference
elements.description: Reference to a data store.

elements.name: sequenceFlow
elements.description: Connects two flow nodes.

elements.name: property
elements.description: A data property of a flow element.

elements.name: dataInputAssociation
elements.description: Maps data into an activity.

elements.name: dataOutputAssociation
elements.description: Maps data out of an activity.

elements.name: sourceRef
elements.description: Id reference (element text) to a data source.

elements.name: targetRef
elements.description: Id reference (element text) to a data target.

elements.name: expression
elements.description: An expression; FEEL in Camunda 8.

elements.name: formalExpression
elements.description: An expression with a language.

elements.name: conditionExpression
elements.description: Condition of a sequence flow.

elements.name: completionCondition
elements.description: When a multi-instance activity or ad-hoc sub-process completes.

elements.name: loopCardinality
elements.description: How often a multi-instance activity runs.

elements.name: multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics
elements.description: Runs an activity once per item or a fixed number of times.

elements.name: eventDefinition
elements.description: What triggers or is raised by an event.

elements.name: timerEventDefinition
elements.description: A point in time, a duration or a cycle.

elements.name: timeDate
elements.description: A fixed date and time.

elements.name: timeDuration
elements.description: A duration.

elements.name: timeCycle
elements.description: A repeating interval.

elements.name: errorEventDefinition
elements.description: Catches or throws a BPMN error.

elements.name: escalationEventDefinition
elements.description: Catches or throws an escalation.

elements.name: messageEventDefinition
elements.description: Catches or sends a message.

elements.name: signalEventDefinition
elements.description: Catches or broadcasts a signal.

elements.name: conditionalEventDefinition
elements.description: Fires when a condition becomes true.

elements.name: condition
elements.description: The condition of a conditional event definition.

elements.name: linkEventDefinition
elements.description: Connects a link throw event to its catch event by name.

elements.name: cancelEventDefinition
elements.description: Cancels a transaction.

elements.name: terminateEventDefinition
elements.description: Ends the whole process instance.

elements.name: compensateEventDefinition
elements.description: Triggers or catches compensation.

elements.name: process
elements.description: An executable or documentation-only workflow.

elements.name: laneSet
elements.description: Groups lanes.

elements.name: lane
elements.description: A partition of a process by role or system.

elements.name: flowNodeRef
elements.description: Id reference (element text) to a flow node in the lane.

elements.name: childLaneSet
elements.description: Nested lanes.

elements.name: collaboration
elements.description: Interaction between participants.

elements.name: participant
elements.description: A pool: a party in a collaboration, optionally backed by a process.

elements.name: messageFlow
elements.description: A message sent between two participants.

elements.name: message
elements.description: A message payload definition.

elements.name: error
elements.description: A BPMN error definition.

elements.name: escalation
elements.description: An escalation definition.

elements.name: signal
elements.description: A signal definition.

elements.name: category
elements.description: A set of category values, e.g. for groups.

elements.name: categoryValue
elements.description: One value of a category.

elements.name: artifact
elements.description: Diagram annotation that does not affect the flow.

elements.name: textAnnotation
elements.description: Free text attached to the diagram.

elements.name: text
elements.description: The text of a text annotation.

elements.name: association
elements.description: Links an artifact to a flow element.

elements.name: group
elements.description: Visual grouping of elements, optionally categorised.
